page.overview:
Who is Shapesmith?

Lizard League Powerplex Team Evil Invincible:

Shapesmith is a supporting character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

Born from the planet Mars, he is the second Martian to leave Mars and later on disguises himself as Rus Livingston in the planet Earth. He would later become a superhero and was selected as the new member of the Guardians of the Globe.

In his super hero form, Shapesmith changes his skin to appear to be wearing a blue and orange suit, with a geometric S on his chest, and appears to be wearing a blue domino mask. In his true Martian form, he doesn't appear to have any visible difference from any other Martian seen in the series, although in his brief appearance he is seen with larger orange pupils than the others.
